evidence.note: Flat white background with no texture or grain; diagram nodes are large rounded white cards with soft shadows and roughly 22px dark labels.
Large dark serif title; body copy is about 26px mid-grey on white with generous line height.
Connectors are about 2px strokes: the grey ones are mid-contrast, the blue and red ones saturated. They read as thin lines, not hairlines.
At the small size the arrows shrink to roughly 1.5px and the check badges to about 14px, but they stay visible. Node labels and the callout text (about 15px dark) stay legible.
Chapter nav links are small (about 12px) grey chrome text, the smallest text on the slide.
A large opaque insight card with big dark serif text; the background is blurred on purpose, not grain.

rationale: The slide uses flat colour, big soft rounded cards and generous dark type, with no texture, grain or grid hairlines. The thinnest elements (the 2px grey connectors, the small check badges and the nav chrome at 1288x598) are still mid-to-high contrast and not essential fine detail, so compression would not erase the message. This fits the pass descriptor.
